jobs.title: Technical Product Marketing Engineer, Robotics Simulation - New College Grad 2027
jobs.description:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world!

We are looking for a Technical Product Marketing Engineer to build robotics simulation workflows and demonstrate how AI models can solve robotics tasks. You will develop working examples, evaluate their behavior and performance, and turn your findings into practical resources that help developers understand and adopt NVIDIA robotics technologies. As part of NVIDIA’s Robotics Technical Marketing team, you will work with engineering, product management, and product marketing to connect technical capabilities with developer needs. You will own well-defined projects—from implementation and testing through demonstrations and technical content—with mentorship and technical review from experienced teammates.

What You Will Be Doing

Develop and test robotics simulation w/ agentic workflows using NVIDIA platforms Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, including configuring robot models, environments, sensors, and task scenarios.
Integrate AI models and robot policies into simulation workflows, connecting simulation inputs, model inference, and robot behavior.
Build reusable Python code and sample applications that demonstrate practical robotics use cases.
Evaluate task success, runtime performance, and failure cases through repeatable experiments; document configurations, results, and limitations.
Create demos, tutorials, technical blogs, and workflow guides that explain what you built, how it works, and how developers can reproduce the results.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to troubleshoot integration issues, validate technical claims, and surface opportunities to improve the developer experience.
Present your work and contribute to technical demonstrations and educational materials for developers, partners, and customer-facing teams.

What We Need To See

Pursuing or recently completed a BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
Strong Python programming fundamentals, including experience debugging, testing, and organizing code.
Hands-on academic, research, internship, or personal project experience with robotics or simulation.
Foundational understanding of linear algebra, coordinate transformations, and robotics concepts such as sensors, kinematics, or control.
Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals and practical experience running or evaluating models using a framework such as PyTorch.
Ability to investigate technical problems systematically and communicate results through clear writing and presentations.
Initiative in learning new tools, incorporating feedback, and following through on defined technical deliverables.
Relevant experience may come from coursework, capstone projects, research, internships, open-source contributions, or personal projects.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or other robotics simulators.
A project applying learned policies or pre-trained AI models to robotics tasks, such as perception, manipulation, or navigation.
Exposure to reinforcement learning, imitation learning, synthetic data generation, or simulation-to-real evaluation.
Familiarity with Linux, Git, ROS 2, C++, or GPU-accelerated computing.
Examples of reusable code, demonstrations, tutorials, or technical presentations that make a complex topic understandable and help others reproduce your work.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 84,000 USD - 143,750 USD for Level 1, and 100,000 USD - 161,000 USD for Level 2.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 23, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Sr. Editorial Content Marketing Manager , Amazon Ads
jobs.description:
Description

The Senior Content Marketing Manager sits within the Global Content & Creative Studio on the Amazon Ads Marketing team. We are seeking a versatile, AI-forward content marketer who combines exceptional writing and storytelling skills with strong program management capabilities to drive our brand content strategy at scale. In this highly cross-functional role, you'll be responsible for both creating compelling content—leveraging AI tools—and program managing the production of content through agencies and third-party publishers.

This role is uniquely positioned at the intersection of content creation and content operations. You will translate brand strategy and narrative-driven messaging frameworks into customer-facing content while simultaneously building and managing the systems, partnerships, and workflows that enable content production at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Translate narrative-driven messaging frameworks into compelling, high-quality website editorial content across all stages of the funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion) and all customer cohorts (Enterprise, SMB, Agency)

Write and deliver thought leadership content, articles, sponsored content, case studies, video scripts, research narratives, guides, blog posts, and other formats that drive brand awareness and shift perceptions through data-driven storytelling

Program manage the end-to-end production of branded/sponsored content initiatives with premium third-party publishers, from ideation through execution

Leverage AI tools (e.g., generative AI platforms, AI writing assistants, custom AI agents) as a core part of the content creation workflow to increase messaging consistency and scale of content output

Serve as a brand guardian and content quality bar raiser, ensuring all content—whether created internally, by AI tools, or by external partners—meets Amazon Ads editorial standards and brand guidelines

Champion AI-first content creation methodologies across the marketing organization, sharing learnings, best practices, and demonstrating the art of the possible with AI-assisted content development

Develop and maintain a content calendar that balances always-on content needs with campaign-driven initiatives and emerging opportunities

A day in the life

The day-to-day of this role blends hands-on content creation with strategic program management. You might start your morning using AI tools to draft a thought leadership article based on a brand narrative brief, then shift to reviewing sponsored content deliverables from a publisher partner against brand guidelines. After lunch, you could be leading a cross-functional alignment meeting on messaging consistency, followed by optimizing your AI content workflows based on performance data. You'll regularly context-switch between writing compelling copy with AI assistance, managing external partner timelines and deliverables, evangelizing brand narratives to stakeholder teams, and experimenting with new ways to push content quality and velocity.

To be successful, you will need to establish clear processes, set prioritization, and communicate effectively with internal and external customers. The right candidate will be a self-starter who is deeply curious about AI's potential to transform content marketing, has strong interpersonal and project management skills, and maintains an extremely high bar for content quality.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
Bachelor's degree
2+ years of experience using AI tools (AI writing assistants, AI content platforms) in a professional content creation capacity
Demonstrated ability to manage complex, highly visible projects with aggressive deadlines across multiple simultaneous workstreams
Experience managing external agency and publisher relationships, including contract execution and deliverable management
Proven track record of writing and delivering high-quality B2B content across multiple formats (news articles, thought leadership, case studies, sponsored content)
Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
Digital advertising and advertising technology industry experience
Experience leading innovative creative development from concept to delivery across internal teams, external agencies, and publishers
Experience with sponsored content and branded content partnerships with premium B2B publishers
Experience developing governance frameworks, content standards, and operational processes for content marketing programs
Experience with B2B marketing measurement and attribution, including content performance analytics

jobs.title: Talent Marketing Manager, AIM (Attraction, Influence and Marketing)
jobs.description:
Description

We're reinventing how to attract and hire quality talent at scale — come join us.

We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to lead the strategy, execution and performance behind two of the AIM organization's most critical marketing functions: activation management and integrated marketing and campaign planning across Workforce Staffing's global hiring portfolio. This role starts with the customer: understanding hiring needs, translating them into marketing goals, and owning how those goals are achieved. You define how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are strategically planned, measured and optimized, and how the team scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.

As a marketing strategist and cross-functional operator, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across priority geographies globally. You translate complex performance data into decisive activation recommendations, manage daily pacing and spend governance, and own the narrative for senior leadership. You flex between deep-focus, data-rich environments and wide-focus, relationship-heavy environments with equal confidence.

You shape organizational strategy, build trust, drive clarity, and solve problems before they escalate.

Your insights don't just inform decisions — they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps and align business managers on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement. You build the trust, mechanisms, and reporting that close the existing gap. You don't wait for perfect data — you make decisions with what exists and build toward what's needed.

Key job responsibilities

Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the annual marketing strategy and plan the direction for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order trajectory across your portfolio. Lead quarterly strategy reviews, updating priorities based on performance data, market shifts, and evolving business needs. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Push back on media recommendations with data where channel performance does not support continued investment.

Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across assigned markets, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for assigned markets, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events. Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate changing labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive collaboration with Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Creative, Talent Engagement, Marketing Analytics, and Business stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams. Bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Manage a wide portfolio of countries with varying levels of data maturity, labour order certainty, and stakeholder sophistication.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Oversee daily pacing reviews, implementing ramp-down or pause decisions when application delivery targets are met. Share insights with Performance Marketing to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own escalation thresholds and spend decision governance.

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment: Own weekly and monthly Business Review deep dive presentations for senior leadership, translating risk sites and marketing performance into clear strategic narrative. Maintain regular alignment with Business Managers and cross-functional partners on fill rate risk and marketing actions. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases. Adapt communication to audience maturity — from sophisticated data-driven forums to foundational trust-building conversations.

Application Quality & Fill Rate Improvement: Monitor performance against goals including fill rate, non-paid application share, spend per hire, and application-to-usable application ratios. Implement data-driven optimisations for underperforming sites. Identify quality gaps (geo-targeting, shift messaging, channel mix) and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Creative, and Owned Marketing teams to resolve. Own the activation logic that balances cost efficiency with fill rate delivery.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes — from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with reviewing overnight pacing data across your markets and making activation decisions for the day. You join the weekly reporting call with your stakeholders, leading the marketing view for your area with a clear recommendation for each at-risk site. Mid-morning, you're on a stakeholder call with business partners in Brazil translating application pacing risk into language they understand and building alignment on marketing levers available. After lunch, you're deep-diving a high-spend site in Germany where channel efficiency has dropped — pulling site-level data, identifying the issue, and producing an internal discussion analysis for the Paid Marketing team. In the afternoon, you're working through quarterly initiatives with other teams — defining what to learn, which markets to test in, and how results will inform next quarter's strategy. Later, you prepare the MBR narrative for senior leadership, connecting this month’s activation decisions to fill rate outcomes. You close the day connecting the dots: what patterns are emerging across your portfolio, what's working, what needs to change, and how to translate that into the quarterly strategy update you're presenting to leadership next week.

About The Team

Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) team achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences — engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
Experience in marketing or marketing research
Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using SQL to pull data and metrics to deliver reports

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Ads Marketing
jobs.description:
Description

Come build the future with us! What unites all Amazonians (across teams and geographies) is that we are all striving to delight customers and make their lives easier, whoever that customer may be. In pursuit of delighting customers, Amazonians have developed many products and services that transformed the way our customers live their lives and run their businesses. Together, we are building the future, one innovative product, service, and idea at a time.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, publishers, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including retail media, display, video, DSP, measurement, and ad tech solutions—leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys.

We're seeking a strategic and customer-obsessed Product Marketing Manager to join our Ads Product Marketing team. In this role, you'll serve as a critical bridge between product development and go-to-market execution, translating complex advertising solutions into compelling narratives that resonate with advertisers and drive product adoption at scale.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you'll partner closely with Product Management, Go-to-Market, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape product strategy through deep customer insights and competitive intelligence. You'll own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle—from informing the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research to crafting positioning and messaging that differentiates our solutions in market. Your work will directly influence how thousands of advertisers discover, adopt, and maximize value from Amazon Ads products.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with creative storytelling, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven track record of launching products that achieve measurable business impact. You'll need to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, moving seamlessly from conducting advertiser research to developing sales enablement materials to presenting product vision to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities

Collaborate with Product Managers to align on customer research priorities that will inform the product roadmap.
Conduct in-depth research and competitive analysis to identify the most promising opportunities for Amazon Ads products.
Communicate the product vision and direction to internal and external stakeholders to drive buy-in and adoption, establishing a regular cadence of stakeholder engagement.
Partner with Product Managers to recommend customer feedback prioritization, support effective Alpha/Beta testing, and refine the strategic roadmap.
Align GTM strategy to the product roadmap, translate complex product information into simple and clear language, and continue to gather customer feedback post-launch to inform future iterations.
Develop single-source-of-truth documentation to enable sales and marketing with positioning, messaging, product availability, best practices, implementation guides, and FAQs.

About The Team

The Ads Product Marketing team within Amazon Ads is the strategic connective tissue between product innovation and market impact. We don't just launch products, we shape how advertisers discover, understand, and derive value from Amazon's advertising solutions across the full funnel.

The Commerce pod sits at the heart of this mission, owning product marketing for some of Amazon Ads' core solutions: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Brand Stores. Together, these products serve millions of advertisers globally from small businesses running their first campaign to the large brands.

This role is part of the Sponsored Products & Sponsored Brands (SPB) product marketing team. We are evolving the PMM function beyond traditional launch communications to earning a seat at the table to directly influence the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research, competitive intelligence, and deep advertiser insights. Our work spans the full marketing lifecycle: from shaping what gets built, to how it's positioned in market, to driving adoption and measuring impact post-launch.

You'll join a collaborative, fast-paced team that partners daily with Product Management, Go-to-Market, Sales Enablement, and cross-functional leadership. We operate with a builder mentality by testing, learning, and iterating to deliver solutions that move the needle for advertisers and for the business. If you're passionate about translating complex ad tech into compelling stories that drive real outcomes, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience communicating results to senior leadership
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience in marketing or marketing research

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

Job Type

Full-time

Description

Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company (biBERK) is building a cloud-first, API-driven insurance platform that enables small business owners to buy commercial policies directly online. We are seeking an analytical and technically minded Marketing Analyst
to join our team in Stamford, CT, to help scale our digital marketing analytics and performance reporting framework.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of growth marketing, data science, and web applications. You will leverage modern AI coding environments (such as Claude, Copilot) alongside core digital tracking tools (Google Ads, GA4) and Python/R web application frameworks to build real-time interactive dashboards. Your efforts will directly inform marketing investment, optimize digital acquisition funnels, and track key operational metrics for senior leadership

This job is hybrid with mandatory in-office days at our Stamford, CT location on a weekly or monthly basis depending on location.

Job Responsibilities

Production Dashboard Engineering: Design, deploy, and support interactive analytical applications and custom web tools using Python (Streamlit) or R (Shiny). Build reporting systems to track direct-to-business marketing metrics, including quote-to-bind ratios, channel attribution, conversion velocities, and other funnel metrics. Use AI to build and maintain these dashboards on an azure environment.
AI-Accelerated Development: Serve as a functional champion for generative AI tools (Claude) within marketing operations. Utilize LLM workflows to accelerate code synthesis, automate data pipelines, and refactor analytical scripts to streamline dashboard delivery timelines.
Cloud & Data Integration: Partner with internal technology teams within the Azure ecosystem to integrate marketing data streams, support data warehouse migrations, and ensure secure deployment of analytical web applications.
Tracking Architecture & GA4 Optimization: Maintain and enhance digital analytics architecture across GA4 and Google Ads. Oversee custom dimension setups, event-driven tag management, and clean B2B lead attribution to ensure high data integrity across all digital channels.
Growth Experimentation & Media Testing: Design, run, and evaluate rigor-based media testing frameworks to measure true marketing incrementality. Execute Conversion Lift studies, Geo-Testing / Match-Market models, and A/B experiments across digital channels.

Requirements

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or business intelligence. Experience in B2B commercial insurance, financial services, or insurtech environments is strongly preferred.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or Data Science.
Location: Must reside within a viable commuting distance of our Stamford, CT office to attend required monthly strategy and team alignment session.
Development & Analytics Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python (Streamlit) and/or R (Shiny) for web application development and data visualization. Deep expertise in GA4 (event tracking, custom dimensions) and Google Ads management platforms. Hands-on experience using Claude/LLMs for code generation, workflow automation, and refactoring.
Database & Cloud: Foundational understanding of the Azure ecosystem for data storage, query optimization, or web application hosting.
Testing Methodologies: Proven understanding of statistical media testing, specifically Conversion Lift testing, Geo-Testing, and A/B experimentation architectures.
Preferred Skills: Prior experience with traditional enterprise BI platforms (Power BI or Tableau) is a plus.

About Us

biBerk is where commercial insurance buyers can obtain coverage for their businesses from insurers of the Berkshire Hathaway group of Insurance Companies, one of the best capitalized insurance groups in the world. Our ultimate parent, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (berkshirehathaway.com) is a holding company with diversified interests in a host of industries, including insurance, energy, transportation and manufacturing. Most policies issued through biBerk.com will be underwritten by Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company ("BHDIC"), which is an AM Best rated A++ insurer.

BHDIC is domiciled in Omaha, Nebraska. BHDIC and the team at biBerk are focused on helping small business owners quickly and easily buy affordable insurance directly from a financially strong insurance company they can trust.

BHDIC is excited to announce our comprehensive benefits package with some new and enhanced features for 2026 that include:

Medical (PPO/HDHP), vision, disability, and life insurance.

Generous PTO plan for all benefit-time eligible employees.

Employee Retirement Savings Plan/401(k) with company match and immediate vesting.
Education Assistance Program that offers 100% upfront tuition reimbursement after 6 months of service for approved degree programs.
Service Recognition Program that provides a monetary award to be used toward a vacation every 5 years of employment.
Wellness Initiatives that include Fitness Center and Weight Watchers Reimbursement programs.
Voluntary benefits that include accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity.
Employee discount and rewards program on travel, tickets, electronics, home, and more.

Description

Are you energized by turning creative ambition into a system that reliably produces it? The Reputation Marketing & Insights Creative team is looking for a Sr Creative Program Manager to own the process and production layer of our operating model, systems, and output for how advertising creative actually gets made. You will report to the L7 Head of Creative, with a dotted line to the org-wide Operations lead. A core part of the role is raising operational consistency across the wider organization.

In practice, you set the standards that the Creative team executes against. You make critical calls on how work flows, where capacity goes, and what "good" looks like operationally — decisions that shape long-term creative output and business outcomes.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and creative production. You thrive on ambiguous problems, lead cross-functional teams without owning the reporting line, and actively explore how generative AI can augment creative production — compressing timelines, expanding output, and lowering cost per asset without lowering the bar.

Key job responsibilities

Execute the org's operations strategy within the creative-production domain — translating operating goals (efficiency, cost, scale, quality) into a concrete production model and deliver against them.

Design, own, and continuously improve the end-to-end creative production operating model — intake, prioritization, resourcing, workflow, review/approval, and delivery.

Set the standards, process, and quality bar for our project management and production outputs

Provide the production-side inputs to org-level operations planning — capacity forecasts, cost-per-asset and throughput data, and resourcing tradeoffs — and translate those inputs into budget and resourcing decisions.

Own capacity and resource planning across the team and external partners — forecast demand, allocate against competing priorities, and make the tradeoff calls when demand exceeds capacity.

Select, implement, and own the systems and tooling that run creative production (project/asset management, workflow automation, reporting), and drive adoption across the team.

Establish the metrics that define production health — throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery, rework, cost per asset — and use them to drive measurable improvement.

Bachelor's degree
7+ years in creative production, creative operations, or program management within a marketing/creative environment.
Experience owning production workflow and resourcing across multiple concurrent programs or campaigns.
Experience leading or providing structured direction to lateral partners.
Experience managing external agencies or production vendors, including budgets and SOWs.

Experience using data and metrics to improve processes and customer satisfaction

Experience scaling creative production across channels (video, digital, social, experiential) and high asset volume.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.

jobs.description:
About TGaS® Advisors

TGaS® Advisors, a division of Trinity Partners, is a leading management advisory firm focused on providing comprehensive benchmarking and advisory solutions to commercial operations leaders across the bio-pharmaceutical industry. TGaS serves clients across the spectrum of large (top 35), mid-sized, and emerging life sciences (pre-commercial) organizations.

TGaS® Advisors contributions help to inform our clients’ commercial structures, operating practices, resource planning and capabilities development.

The Director, Management Advisor, Omnichannel marketing position will report into the Vice President and will support the Omnichannel solution while serving in a client-facing and project management capacity.

During client engagements, the Director, will lead project-level work to evaluate clients’ current and future-state needs as it relates to resources (headcount and financial) and skills/capabilities related to operating practices within a dynamically changing healthcare landscape.

The Director, Omnichannel role is a critical, client-facing position responsible for executing and delivering contracted services; expanding the breadth and depth of value delivered to clients; engaging TGaS’ Operations team in delivery of the highest quality information and analyses; and broadening awareness of the company’s offerings across the bio-pharmaceutical industry.

The Director, Marketing & Omnichannel Activation will perform five key responsibilities:

Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader
Lead Benchmark and Project Engagements
Lead Advisory and Membership Engagements
Identify business development opportunities through active listening and conversations with clients
Contribute to innovation and the growth of the overall solution

Specifically, in the context of each of these four key responsibilities, the Director, Management Advisor, Marketing & Omnichannel Activation will:

Subject Matter Expert And Thought Leader

Serve as a trusted advisor on omnichannel activation, customer engagement, content operations, AI enabled marketing, and commercial transformation
Proactively research trends, capabilities and client needs in regard to marketing engagement models and omnichannel activation capabilities.

Lead Benchmark and Projects with Clients

Lead client engagements and project from initiation through to final delivery
Conduct executive interviews and assess organizational structures, operating models, resource allocation, budgets, processes, and capabilities.
Capture / coordinate receipt of client-provided quantitative and qualitative information for input into TGaS’ database for analysis. Data commonly includes headcount, budgets, skills, operating practices, processes, supportive infrastructure, etc.
Author benchmark engagement reports summarizing client’s resources and capabilities relative to peer set companies and TGaS’ continuums of best practices, including recommendations to improve operational effectiveness/efficiencies to coincide with the client organizations’ current or evolving/future needs
Represent the solution while working collaboratively and cross-functionally with other TGaS teams in the course of client engagements spanning multiple TGaS solutions
Participate in or (where appropriate) value-added client engagements (e.g., strategy and business planning sessions or workshops) which help to drive the value of TGaS benchmark results into clients’ operating practices, processes, or business results

Lead Advisory Services Engagements With Clients

Respond (accurately and in a timely manner) to client inquiries by providing expert and valued guidance that informs client decision-making. Provide ‘urgent, on-call support’
Support the development and execution of an annual plan for producing value-added content for client consumption - achieved through TGaS Advisors’ Virtual How (VHow) network and (survey) process
Identify and implement enhancements to the advisory services process. Conduct routine ‘best practice deep dives’ to be published and distributed to the network of TGaS advisory services clients
Identify and implement enhancements to the advisory services process. Conduct routine ‘best practice deep dives’ to be published and distributed to the network of TGaS advisory services clients
Build trusted relationships with member organizations and proactively identify emerging needs

Business Development / Opportunity Identification

Through ongoing client interactions, identify unmet client needs that are addressable through TGaS offerings
Understand the scope of all TGaS Solutions and engage other solutions based on client needs

Contribute To Innovation

Actively contribute to solution development and evolution of services and offerings that will generate additional revenue
Document unmet client needs and innovative ideas from benchmarks, advisory services and client engagements
Evolve deliverable formats to increase the value TGaS brings to the network and to individual clients.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

The ideal candidate will be a seasoned professional (8-10 years) with experience directing Omnichannel operations in an agency or life science setting. Candidates originating from industries beyond bio-pharmaceuticals and pharmaceuticals consulting will also be considered. The candidate must possess the credibility and experience to both deeply understand how marketing channels are utilized, processes, systems, and advise on related best practices. The position will require a driven person to develop and maintain relationships for continuous client engagement. Prior experience as a consultant or in roles of a consultative capacity is desirable.

In addition, the candidate will have a track record that exemplifies:

Broad knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial operations, marketing operations, omnichannel strategy, or related fields
Comfort working at the highest levels of client organizations, interacting closely with top executives and business unit leaders
An ability to consult, problem-solve, work autonomously, and to organize complex information into clear actionable recommendations that improve (client) business results
Development and management of effective relationships with internal stakeholders and/or clients
Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines simultaneously, coupled with excellent communication skills, including group presentations, verbal and writing abilities.
High integrity and credibility as perceived by all those with whom he/she will work
Change management / process analysis skills
Operate with minimal supervision and proactively seek opportunities without guidance
Education: A Bachelor’s degree is required. An advanced degree is strongly preferred

TGaS has achieved its success by delivering high-caliber solutions to bio-pharmaceutical commercial operations leaders. This effort is enabled by sourcing top talent to the TGaS organization. As such, the ideal candidate will be a confident self-starter who can thrive in a small company environment with a high degree of esprit de corps.

About Trinity

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. By blending deep therapeutic expertise and trusted human ingenuity with a purpose-built technology platform, Trinity accelerates clarity and confidence at every step of the commercialization journey—from pre-launch to scale to loss of exclusivity. For more than 30 years, the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech companies have relied on Trinity’s foresight, execution, and partnership to deliver confident product launches, decisive market advantage, and measurable patient impact. During that time, Trinity expanded from its first office in Waltham, MA to 1,300 professionals across 14 offices and five continents, setting new industry standards in quality, responsiveness, and client partnership. For more information, visit Trinity at www.trinitylifesciences.com.

Trinity’s salary bands account for a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets and market demand for skills, level of experience and training, specific qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and other business/organizational needs. The base salary range for this role is $144,000 - $216,000 per year. In addition to your base salary, you will also be eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus.

Trinity’s Commitment to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)

At Trinity, inclusion and engagement are at the heart of how we work and grow together. We’ve evolved from a traditional “DEI” framework to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)—a model that moves beyond representation to focus on connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. jobs.title: Director, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
About Us

Intellum is the leader in corporate education technology and powers the largest, most successful customer, partner, and employee learning programs in the world. Large brands and fast-moving companies like Google, Meta, Amazon, Walmart, Xero, Atlassian, Mailchimp, Airbnb, Stripe, and TikTok rely on Intellum to engage and educate the audiences they touch.

We have always been a “remote first” company and are proud to have team members located all over the world. We value Curiosity, Creativity, Perseverance, and Kindness and strive to demonstrate these core values every day. Our culture is very important to us. We invest in our people in fun and exciting ways, including personal development budgets and an annual all-company retreat that is focused less on work and more on human connections. We are in growth mode, and our “smart growth” approach ensures that we will continue to scale our company effectively.

The Director of Growth Marketing owns Intellum's qualified pipeline number and the relationships, strategy, and execution it takes to hit it. This leader creates demand at the top of the funnel and turns it into qualified pipeline. Leading indicators show the trajectory early, so the number is predictable and time and budget move to what's working. The role is hands-on and senior, and manages one Sales Development Representative.

Agentic AI and automation sit at the center of how this function runs. The right person already builds with them and will design Intellum's growth engine around them, so qualified pipeline and revenue growth outpaces investment..

This leader is Intellum's go-to-market execution lead and works closest with the CMO, Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Audience & Content, and Customer Marketing.

Responsibilities

Own the quarterly qualified-pipeline target in both opportunity count and dollars. Track leading indicators weekly, adjust targeting and investment to stay on plan, and present results to executives with a clear recommendation on where to invest next.
Build and run the agentic workflows behind growth in Claude, Clay, and n8n, connected through MCP and APIs. Automate account research, enrichment, scoring, routing, and follow-up. Run experiments to decide which buying signals trigger action and who acts on each one.
Create demand at the top of the funnel from priority accounts through events, partner co-marketing, original research, and customer advocacy, built with Audience & Content and Customer Marketing. Measure it on target-account engagement, self-reported attribution, and the pipeline it produces.
Lead account-based marketing as a core enterprise growth motion. Run 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many plays with Sales against priority accounts, and measure them on buying-group engagement, opportunity creation, and deal velocity.
Lead multi-channel go-to-market campaigns with Sales. Pull every team's work into one plan and align SDR focus to the same accounts.
Improve conversion from first engagement to qualified opportunity. Test offers, personalized landing pages, and routing so high-fit accounts move faster.
Direct outside spend. Use paid media where it reaches priority accounts efficiently, judged on CRM-verified pipeline, and manage the contractors and agencies who support creative, web, and analytics.
Manage and coach the SDR, and keep Sales aligned on what counts as a qualified opportunity. Set the standard for account research and handoff, and measure success by accepted opportunities.
Launch every major program with a hypothesis, a baseline, a tracking plan, and a decision rule to scale or stop. Pair attribution with cohort analysis and holdout tests, and share every result with the team.
Travel occasionally for company events and customer meetings. Work across multiple U.S. time zones.
Perform other duties as assigned. We’re a lean team, so count on there being some.

How Success Is Measured

Qualified pipeline in opportunity count and dollars
Engagement and buying-group coverage in priority accounts
Opportunities created in priority accounts
Cost per qualified opportunity
Pipeline acceleration: stage-to-stage conversion rates and days in each stage
Win rate on marketing-sourced pipeline
Expansion pipeline from customer programs
Traffic, form fills, and MQLs are diagnostics.

Required Skills/Experience

8+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation, growth, or revenue marketing, selling into enterprise buying groups with multi-month cycles.
Personally built agentic workflows in Claude, Clay, n8n, or through MCP and APIs that now run parts of a GTM team's work. You can demo them and show what changed.
Built pipeline through events, partners, original research, or customer advocacy, with the qualified pipeline and cost per opportunity to prove it. You measure demand beyond last touch.
Led multi-channel go-to-market campaigns built with Sales, with every team delivering on one timeline.
Built a growth function from an early stage, before a playbook existed, and knows why they built it in that order.
Sets direction from day one and holds the room with executives. You invite challenge from Sales, Product Marketing, and leadership and use it to sharpen the plan.
Maps what a pipeline plan depends on, including data, tracking, routing, and sales capacity, and which pieces must be in place before investment goes out.
Knows what good conversion looks like at each stage of an enterprise funnel and can explain where their own numbers landed.
Ran enterprise ABM more than once and changed the approach based on what the first attempt taught.
Managed SDRs or a similar role, measured on pipeline quality and quantity.
Uses paid media with precision, such as LinkedIn targeting against priority accounts, and checks platform numbers against the CRM.

Preferred Qualifications

Grew a demand or growth function at a private-equity-backed SaaS company moving into larger enterprise deals.
Worked in learning technology, customer education, HR tech, or enablement software.
Built expansion, cross-sell, or referral programs with Customer Marketing.
Presented pipeline performance to PE operating partners or a board.

Education

Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Benefits

Medical - 100% of employee premiums for selected individual plans
Dental - 100% of employee premiums covered
Vision - 100% of employee premiums covered
LinkedIn Learning
401(k) plus matching (US Based Only)
Flexible PTO
Calm subscription
Annual Company Retreat

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Technology Administrator (Remote)
jobs.description:
CLA is a top 10 national professional services firm where our purpose is to
create opportunities
every day, for our clients, our people, and our communities through industry-focused wealth advisory, digital, audit, tax, consulting, and outsourcing services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you.

CLA is dedicated to building a culture that invites different beliefs and perspectives to the table, so we can truly know and help our clients, communities, and each other.

CLA is growing and seeking to hire an experienced Senior Marketing Technology Administrator
to join our talented Information Technology team. The position offers growth, flexibility and a collaborative work environment.

In this position you should have the following; excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate at all levels. Strong problem solving and creative skills and the ability to exercise sound judgment. Most important, demonstrate a high level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results-orientation.

This role serves as an advanced individual contributor and subject matter expert for CLA’s sales and marketing platforms, including CRM. The role supports improvements to system functionality, integration, reporting, process consistency, and user adoption through hands-on analysis, configuration, troubleshooting, and collaboration with business and technical teams.

How you’ll
create opportunities
in this Senior Marketing Technology Administrator role:

Serve as a subject matter expert for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Insights – Journeys, Dataverse, and related marketing technologies, collaborating across functions to support business needs.
Manage assigned incidents, service requests, defects, and enhancement tickets from intake through resolution, including triage, prioritization, documentation, status communication, root-cause analysis, and timely escalation in accordance with established service-level expectations.
Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend out-of-the-box, low-code, integration, or pro-code approaches in partnership with developers and solution architects.
Configure and support Dataverse and model-driven applications, including tables, relationships, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, business process flows, and Power Automate cloud flows.
Maintain role-based security configurations by applying approved business units, security roles, teams, column-level security, auditing, and data privacy requirements.
Support application lifecycle management activities, including solutions, environment variables, connection references, deployment documentation, and releases across development, test, UAT, and production environments.
Develop test scenarios and participate in system, integration, regression, user acceptance, production validation, and post-deployment support activities.
Monitor platform health, automation and integration failures, API usage, storage capacity, performance, and Microsoft service updates; investigate issues and coordinate remediation as needed.
Assess relevant Microsoft release-wave changes and support impact analysis, testing, communication, and adoption planning.
Support integration efforts with enterprise applications using Dataverse APIs, standard or custom connectors, Azure services, and approved middleware.
Maintain data quality through validation, migration support, duplicate management, cleansing, retention, auditing, and integration monitoring.
Identify automation and process-improvement opportunities and implement approved enhancements that improve efficiency and user experience.
Partner with security, privacy, compliance, architecture, development, and business teams to ensure solutions follow organizational standards.
Maintain functional specifications, technical documentation, test evidence, deployment plans.
Provide advanced user support, deliver training, share knowledge with team members, and promote effective system adoption.
Evaluate platform capabilities, including Copilot and AI features, and provide analysis for secure and responsible business use.

What You Will Need

4 years of relevant experience required
Experience with Dynamics CRM or Marketing systems is preferred
Bachelor's degree or a combination of relevant experience and training may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Technical Competencies

Advanced experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Insights – Journeys, Microsoft Dataverse, and model-driven applications.
Hands-on knowledge of tables, relationships, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, business process flows, duplicate detection, auditing, and role-based security.
Strong working knowledge of Power Automate, including flow design, error handling, monitoring, connection management, and performance considerations.
Working knowledge of Power Apps, Power BI, Microsoft 365 integrations, Copilot Studio, and responsible use of Copilot capabilities.
Experience with application release documentation, and deployment strategies.
Understanding of Dataverse integration patterns, REST APIs, webhooks, custom connectors, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, middleware, and service accounts.
Ability to read and troubleshoot JavaScript, FetchXML, Power Fx, JSON, and basic SQL; familiarity with C#/.NET plug-ins is preferred.
Knowledge of platform limits, licensing considerations, capacity management, environment strategy, data-loss-prevention policies, auditing, backup, and disaster-recovery concepts.
Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for release tracking.
Experience with ticket management in tools like Service now
Experience creating functional specifications, solution documentation, process maps, acceptance criteria, test plans, traceability records, deployment plans.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
Experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery methods and collaborating with developers, architects, testers, administrators, and business stakeholders.
Experience with XrmToolBox, Power Platform administration tools, Customer Insights, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar CRM troubleshooting or productivity tools.

Our approach to compensation emphasizes collaboration and career growth. We pay competitive wages and view compensation as an investment in our people. Factors such as geography, experience, education, skills, and knowledge may impact position of pay within the range.

The compensation range for this position in Minneapolis is: 81,000.00 – $139,000.00

The compensation range for this position in Virginia is: 103,000.00 – $155,000.00

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

To support our CLA family members, we focus on their physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being and offer comprehensive benefit options that include health, dental, vision, 401k and much more.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Hi, Future Homie!

At Homebase, you’ll join a team that’s bold, fast-moving, and obsessed with helping small businesses thrive. We build with empathy, act with urgency, and take big swings that drive real-world impact. Here, every Homie shows up to raise the bar, support one another, and celebrate wins as a team.

We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?

📍 Your impact starts here

As our Senior Marketing Operations Manager
, you will make sure marketers get the data they need quickly and reliably, in a form they can use.

You will work daily with Growth, Lifecycle, Analytics, Data Engineering, and Product, and you will be someone both marketers and engineers want to work with.

This is a hands-on, technical role for a builder who is comfortable with integration work and uses AI to change how work gets done.

What You'll Own

Marketing data access

Understand what data every marketer needs, where it lives, and where the gaps are, and be the front door for getting it delivered quickly.
Build self-serve paths for common needs such as segments and audiences, and test implementations end to end with Lifecycle and Engineering.

Pipelines and integrations

Build and maintain data flows between our product and data systems and our marketing and ad tools (Iterable, Amplitude, Salesforce, Meta CAPI, Google Ads, Apple Search Ads), including conversion signal quality, identity resolution, and deduplication.
Partner with RevOps on Salesforce, sending marketing data in and bringing key events back.

Monitoring, quality, and documentation

Monitor key data flows and catch problems before marketers do. Make sure the data feeding attribution is accurate. You will not build the attribution model.
Own data governance and documentation: definitions, naming, UTM standards, playbooks, and intake processes.

Marketing systems and enablement

Serve as technical owner of the marketing stack, resolve lifecycle and advertising requests directly, and implement tags for new channels and partners.

Project ownership and partnership

Own projects end to end, plan ahead with Lifecycle so Engineering inputs are identified early, and recommend simplifying redundant tools as our stack evolves.
Use AI for documentation, QA, anomaly detection, and workflow automation.

🚀 The foundation for success

5 to 8 years in marketing operations, marketing technology, go-to-market engineering, or marketing data roles.
A track record of building the connectors, pipelines, or processes that make product and engineering data usable by marketing.
Strong SQL and comfort with APIs, webhooks, and event schemas. Scripting (Python or JavaScript) is a plus.
Range across lifecycle and automation tools (for example Iterable, Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, or Marketo), event or CDP tools (Amplitude, Segment, or similar), and a data warehouse. We value breadth over deep expertise in a single vendor. Familiarity with Salesforce.
Working knowledge of pixels, tags, UTMs, ad platform conversion APIs, and identity resolution.
AI fluency: you use AI in real work, or can clearly describe how you would apply it and verify the result.
A strong collaborator who can translate between technical and non-technical colleagues, and who builds trust with both.
A self-starter who has inherited a messy environment, made a plan, and executed without waiting to be told what to do.

Nice to have:
paid acquisition data experience, exposure to Hotjar or AI search visibility tools such as Profound, and a go-to-market engineering background.

This role is probably not for you if

You are looking for a clean, fully documented environment and a large team around you from day one.
Your strength is building and launching campaigns. This role is about the data and systems underneath them.
You prefer to hand off technical work and manage others rather than build it yourself. We need a doer right now.

What You'll Gain

Ownership of a mission-critical data and systems layer that every marketer depends on.
Visibility across the go-to-market organization and a real say in how we scale.

🤝 The Homie Way -
These principles guide everything we do—from how we work and make decisions to how we show up for each other.

💡 Be Customer Obsessed – Solve problems with empathy and creativity.
⚡ Move Fast, Learn Fast – Experiment, take action, and grow every day.
🎯 Own Your Impact – Think big, focus on what matters, and make decisions you stand behind.
🏆 Master Your Craft – Excellence fuels impact—show up, step up, and make your mark.
🏅 Win Together – Put goals over roles, lead with trust, and connect to our mission and each other.

What We Offer (United States)

💰 Ownership & Financial Security: Stock options + 401(k) with 4% match
🏥 Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage + FSA options
⏰ Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO + company holidays + designated focus periods
🤖 AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn't have a paywall. That means you'll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.
👶 Family Support: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave (after 6 months of service)
🛡️ Protection Plans: Life insurance + short/long-term disability coverage
🌟 Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly
🍽️ Workspace Perks: Meals provided, commuter benefits, team offsites, and Customer Days
💼 Our Hybrid Rhythm: We believe collaboration drives impact. That’s why Tuesday and Wednesday are our required in-office days—a time to move faster as a team, build deeper connections, make better decisions, and build together.

What We Offer (Canada)

💰 Ownership & Savings: Stock options + TFSA/RRSP with 4% company match
🏥 Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents
⏰ Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO + company holidays + designated focus periods
🤖 AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn't have a paywall. That means you'll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.
👶 Family Support: Maternity/Parental Leave EI top-up support offered (after 6 months of service)
🌟 Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly
🛡️ Protection Plans: Life insurance + short/long-term disability coverage
🍽️ Workspace Perks: Meals provided, team offsites, and Customer Days
💼 Our Hybrid Rhythm: We believe collaboration drives impact. That’s why Tuesday and Wednesday are our required in-office days—a time to move faster as a team, build deeper connections, make better decisions, and build together.

What To Expect During The Interview Process

Meet the Talent Acquisition team, Rachel U.
Meet the Hiring Manager, Volodymyr G.
Participate in a Talent Showcase
Meet the CMO, Matt M.
Background Check + Offer Stage
Welcome to the team, Homie 🎉

💜 Belonging at Homebase -
We're committed to fostering a welcoming space where every Homie can be their full self. Experience comes in many forms—so if you're excited about this role, even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply!

Homebase will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

👋 Hey, We’re Homebase

Homebase is the everything app for hourly teams—built to simplify the day-to-day and superpower local businesses. With tools for scheduling, time clocks, payroll, communication, HR, and more, we help teams stay connected and in control. Today, over 150,000 small (but mighty) businesses rely on us to make work radically easier. Together, we’ve tracked over a billion hours for 2M+ workers—and we’re just getting started.

jobs.title: Field & Marketing Operations Intern
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Job Title

Field & Marketing Operations Intern

Why Genmab

At Genmab, interns don’t just learn about the work - they help move it forward. Our internship program provides meaningful, hands-on experience through real projects that directly support our teams, business priorities, and mission to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases.

From day one, interns are welcomed as part of the team and given opportunities to contribute, collaborate, and make an impact. Along the way, you’ll learn from talented colleagues and senior leaders, build new skills, expand your professional network, and gain exposure to the innovative work happening across Genmab.

We’re always looking for smart, curious, purpose-led people who are ready to bring fresh perspectives and bold ideas. Explore our website to learn more about Genmab and how you could play a role in our bold, extra[not]ordinary® future.

Job Overview

The Field & Marketing Operations Intern will support Genmab’s U.S. team across Operational Excellence and Field Operations, helping strengthen the processes, tools, and communications that enable effective execution across our growing portfolio.

Working alongside experienced team members, the intern will contribute to projects involving vendor management, print production, speaker programs, sponsorships, field communications, Alignments, Meetings and operational reporting. This role offers an opportunity to apply analytical, organizational, and communication skills to meaningful business needs while gaining experience in the biotechnology industry.

What You’ll Do

Operational Excellence

Assess the contract intake form and supporting workflow to identify opportunities to improve data quality, simplify requests, and enhance the user experience through technology.
Help develop process documentation, standard operating procedures, job aids, and training materials.
Support process improvement projects across vendor management, print production, speaker programs, and sponsorships.
Review workflows for requests, approvals, contracting, and invoicing to identify opportunities for simplification and improved tracking.
Assist with project coordination, action tracking, and documentation of decisions and next steps.

Field Operations

Support the development and coordination of field communications across key capabilities, helping ensure information is clear, timely, and actionable.
Assist with organizing and validating information used in field planning, deployment, roster management, and operational reporting.
Help prepare job aids and training materials for field tools and processes, including CRM and reporting capabilities.
Gather feedback from internal partners and help identify opportunities to improve the support provided to U.S. field teams.

Analytics, Technology & Process Improvement

Analyze operational data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
Assist with developing reports, dashboards, and presentations that communicate findings and recommendations to leadership.
Participate in automation and digital transformation initiatives, including testing, documentation, and adoption activities.
Contribute to a defined summer project and present findings, recommendations, and completed deliverables at the end of the internship.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in business management, analytics, information systems, communications, or a related field.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
An analytical mindset and an interest in using data to solve business problems.
Interest in process improvement, operational excellence, and the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
Ability to collaborate with colleagues across functions, ask thoughtful questions, and take initiative.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

Experience with Power BI, workflow automation, or similar reporting and productivity tools is a plus.

General Intern Information – Date/Location/Schedule

Internships will take place over 10 weeks from June – August 2027. This role will be based in Princeton, NJ and operate on a required hybrid schedule – 3 days in the office and 2 days remote per week. This role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship at the time of the application or in the future.

What’s next?

Help us learn about you by submitting a complete and thoughtful application, which includes your resume. Your application and resume are a way for us to initially get to know you, so it’s important to complete all relevant questions to ensure we have as much information about you as possible.

Every application matters to us, and we’ll carefully review each submission as quickly as possible to see if your qualifications align with the role. While we’re unable to provide individual updates, rest assured that we’re working diligently to move through the process efficiently.

If you move forward in the process, you’ll receive an email invitation to connect with us and dive deeper into this exciting opportunity. The final stage will bring selected candidates meeting directly with our hiring teams, where you’ll have the chance to showcase your potential. We are committed to keeping you informed and will share decisions with all candidates as soon as we are able. We can't wait to see where this journey takes you!

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

jobs.description:
CLA is a top 10 national professional services firm where our purpose is to
create opportunities
every day, for our clients, our people, and our communities through industry-focused wealth advisory, digital, audit, tax, consulting, and outsourcing services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you.

CLA is dedicated to building a culture that invites different beliefs and perspectives to the table, so we can truly know and help our clients, communities, and each other.

CLA is growing and seeking to hire an experienced Senior Marketing Technology Administrator
to join our talented Information Technology team. The position offers growth, flexibility and a collaborative work environment.

In this position you should have the following; excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate at all levels. Strong problem solving and creative skills and the ability to exercise sound judgment. Most important, demonstrate a high level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results-orientation.

This role serves as an advanced individual contributor and subject matter expert for CLA’s sales and marketing platforms, including CRM. The role supports improvements to system functionality, integration, reporting, process consistency, and user adoption through hands-on analysis, configuration, troubleshooting, and collaboration with business and technical teams.

How you’ll
create opportunities
in this Senior Marketing Technology Administrator role:

Serve as a subject matter expert for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Insights – Journeys, Dataverse, and related marketing technologies, collaborating across functions to support business needs.
Manage assigned incidents, service requests, defects, and enhancement tickets from intake through resolution, including triage, prioritization, documentation, status communication, root-cause analysis, and timely escalation in accordance with established service-level expectations.
Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend out-of-the-box, low-code, integration, or pro-code approaches in partnership with developers and solution architects.
Configure and support Dataverse and model-driven applications, including tables, relationships, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, business process flows, and Power Automate cloud flows.
Maintain role-based security configurations by applying approved business units, security roles, teams, column-level security, auditing, and data privacy requirements.
Support application lifecycle management activities, including solutions, environment variables, connection references, deployment documentation, and releases across development, test, UAT, and production environments.
Develop test scenarios and participate in system, integration, regression, user acceptance, production validation, and post-deployment support activities.
Monitor platform health, automation and integration failures, API usage, storage capacity, performance, and Microsoft service updates; investigate issues and coordinate remediation as needed.
Assess relevant Microsoft release-wave changes and support impact analysis, testing, communication, and adoption planning.
Support integration efforts with enterprise applications using Dataverse APIs, standard or custom connectors, Azure services, and approved middleware.
Maintain data quality through validation, migration support, duplicate management, cleansing, retention, auditing, and integration monitoring.
Identify automation and process-improvement opportunities and implement approved enhancements that improve efficiency and user experience.
Partner with security, privacy, compliance, architecture, development, and business teams to ensure solutions follow organizational standards.
Maintain functional specifications, technical documentation, test evidence, deployment plans.
Provide advanced user support, deliver training, share knowledge with team members, and promote effective system adoption.
Evaluate platform capabilities, including Copilot and AI features, and provide analysis for secure and responsible business use.

What You Will Need

4 years of relevant experience required
Experience with Dynamics CRM or Marketing systems is preferred
Bachelor's degree or a combination of relevant experience and training may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Technical Competencies

Advanced experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Insights – Journeys, Microsoft Dataverse, and model-driven applications.
Hands-on knowledge of tables, relationships, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, business process flows, duplicate detection, auditing, and role-based security.
Strong working knowledge of Power Automate, including flow design, error handling, monitoring, connection management, and performance considerations.
Working knowledge of Power Apps, Power BI, Microsoft 365 integrations, Copilot Studio, and responsible use of Copilot capabilities.
Experience with application release documentation, and deployment strategies.
Understanding of Dataverse integration patterns, REST APIs, webhooks, custom connectors, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, middleware, and service accounts.
Ability to read and troubleshoot JavaScript, FetchXML, Power Fx, JSON, and basic SQL; familiarity with C#/.NET plug-ins is preferred.
Knowledge of platform limits, licensing considerations, capacity management, environment strategy, data-loss-prevention policies, auditing, backup, and disaster-recovery concepts.
Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for release tracking.
Experience with ticket management in tools like Service now
Experience creating functional specifications, solution documentation, process maps, acceptance criteria, test plans, traceability records, deployment plans.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
Experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery methods and collaborating with developers, architects, testers, administrators, and business stakeholders.
Experience with XrmToolBox, Power Platform administration tools, Customer Insights, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar CRM troubleshooting or productivity tools.

Our approach to compensation emphasizes collaboration and career growth. We pay competitive wages and view compensation as an investment in our people. Factors such as geography, experience, education, skills, and knowledge may impact position of pay within the range.

The compensation range for this position in Minneapolis is: 81,000.00 – $139,000.00

The compensation range for this position in Virginia is: 103,000.00 – $155,000.00
