jobs.title: Paid Media Manager
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.
Your Impact

We are looking for a highly motivated, data-driven Paid Media Manager to own and elevate Axon’s targeted paid advertising strategies. In this role, you will lead end-to-end strategy, execution, and continuous optimization across our paid digital channels. 
Beyond channel management, you will serve as both an analytical steward and a persuasive creative force, crafting compelling, high-converting ad copy and integrating paid media channels directly into our reporting tools for transparent, real-time ROI tracking. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Creative, Web, and Marketing Ops teams to build aligned, performance-driven campaigns that resonate with our specialized audiences. If you thrive on finding high-intent opportunities, relentlessly pursuing performance efficiency, and turning analytics into growth, you will play a transformative role in driving Axon's global mission.
  What You’ll Do

Location:
Scottsdale, Boston, or Seattle Office (Hybrid Schedule: Mon remote, Tues-Fri in office)
Reports to:
Head of Digital Marketing
Direct reports:
None
Build and own the annual paid media plan, including channel mix, audience strategy, and testing roadmap, and present results, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership. 
Develop, launch, and optimize campaigns across paid search, paid social, programmatic and display, retargeting, YouTube, industry publications, and ABM platforms. 
Conduct ongoing keyword research and trend analysis to identify high-intent opportunities for campaign expansion and performance improvement.
Connect ad platforms with CRM, marketing automation, and analytics tools to ensure accurate, real-time tracking of ROI, attribution, and conversions, and report on performance with clear strategy recommendations and A/B testing opportunities for key stakeholders.
Monitor spend, pacing, and performance metrics, making data-driven adjustments and bid updates to maximize efficiency.
Reach niche audiences while adhering to compliance, brand, and platform policy requirements. 
Ensure alignment between paid programs and broader product and growth marketing initiatives, as well as paid and organic search strategies, for cohesive performance across all digital touchpoints.
Partner with global and localization teams to extend paid campaigns into international markets, adapting strategy and messaging for regional audiences and privacy requirements. 
Craft copy that drives conversions. Collaborate with creative, web, and content teams on ad design, landing pages, and conversion rate optimization. 
Stay up to date with digital marketing trends, algorithm updates, and emerging ad tech to continuously refine strategies.

What You Bring

7+ years of experience in B2B digital marketing, directly managing performance-focused paid campaigns.
Deep expertise in search engine marketing (SEM) and intent-based keyword strategy, with a working knowledge of SEO and how it complements paid.
Advanced hands-on experience with Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, plus experience with additional paid channels such as programmatic, paid social, or ABM platforms.
Experience integrating ad channels with marketing automation platforms, CRM, and analytics reporting tools.
Strong analytical capabilities with a proven ability to translate complex datasets into actionable growth insights.
Proactive, curious, solution-oriented, and highly collaborative mindset with exceptional attention to detail and campaign pacing skills.
Strong copywriting skills with experience crafting high-performing, conversion-focused ad and landing page copy.

Benefits that Benefit You

Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
Discretionary paid time off
Paid parental leave for all
Medical, Dental, Vision plans
Fitness Programs
Emotional & Mental Wellness support
Learning & Development programs
And yes, we have snacks in our offices

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Marketing - Resy
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together.

Resy is the American Express global dining platform within U.S. Consumer Services (USCS). Our mission is to power the world’s best restaurants, using technology to imagine the future of hospitality. Our customers discover the amazing world of restaurants thanks to our content-rich website and innovative mobile app. Our diners are insiders, and we love having them at the table. The team is responsible for reimagining hospitality and redefining the way restaurants and diners connect through a single network.

Interested in joining our team of restaurant-obsessed explorers? Right this way.   

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior
Analyst, Venue Retention & Lifecycle Marketing
, to support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention, nurture, and B2B content marketing strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Venue Lifecycle and Retention Marketing
, this role will play a key part in bringing data-driven, multi-channel marketing programs to life that deepen restaurant partner engagement, strengthen loyalty, drive product adoption, and support long-term partner retention.

This individual will work closely with the Manager of Venue Retention Marketing to execute partner nurture strategies and B2B content programs across the venue lifecycle
, translating strategic priorities, partner insights, and product value into relevant and compelling communications. They will own key executional workstreams across email and editorial content
including the B2B Content Calendar and end-to-end development of Resy’s partner eNewsletter, while supporting the development and execution of trigger-based and ongoing nurture journeys.

The role will sit at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, B2B content, email execution, and marketing operations
. This person will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and other teams to move campaigns and initiatives from ideation and briefing through development, approval, deployment, measurement, and optimization. They will bring strong operational rigor to the team, ensuring that multiple campaigns, stakeholders, approvals, and deadlines are effectively managed.

The ideal candidate is an organized and execution-oriented marketer with strong email, editorial, and social instincts and analytical curiosity
. They are equally comfortable developing a content idea, building an email campaign, coordinating a legal review, analyzing campaign performance, and managing a complex project plan. They have a desire to understand our hospitality partners and use data-driven lifecycle marketing to create communications that deliver meaningful value.

Responsibilities

Support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention and lifecycle marketing strategy, bringing partner-facing content and communications to life across email, editorial, and social channels.
Lead execution of partner email and lifecycle programs, including Resy’s partner eNewsletter, developing relevant, engaging communications across key partner moments while evolving and optimizing evergreen engagement strategies.
Manage Resy’s B2B editorial ecosystem, including supporting blog maintenance and owning the content calendar, translating product capabilities, industry trends, partner stories, and business priorities into timely partner-facing content.
Partner with the Manager to advance personalization, segmentation, and ongoing optimization of email and content, using partner insights and performance data to improve the relevance and effectiveness of communications.
Support cross-functional campaign execution, partnering with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, Compliance, and other stakeholders to keep initiatives aligned and on track.
Support the development of partner retention and loyalty strategies, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement through new channels, programs, events, and partner experiences.
Maintain strong operational processes and project management across campaigns and content, ensuring clear timelines, approvals, documentation, and performance reporting.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, and other teams to ensure partner communications reflect shared business objectives.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, email, B2B, content, digital, or integrated marketing, ideally within a SaaS, technology, hospitality, or partner-focused organization.
Hands-on experience developing and executing email or lifecycle marketing campaigns, with an understanding of campaign development from audience definition and content creation through QA, deployment, and reporting.
Strong editorial and writing skills, with the ability to generate content ideas and translate business priorities, product capabilities, and audience needs into clear and compelling B2B communications; familiarity with SEO principles is a plus.
Experience supporting or executing nurture and lifecycle marketing programs, with an understanding of segmentation, personalization, behavioral triggers, and journey-based marketing; familiarity with HubSpot is a plus.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use campaign performance, CRM data, partner feedback, research, and other qualitative and quantitative insights to inform marketing decisions and identify opportunities for optimization.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and approval processes.
Experience navigating Compliance, Brand, or other structured marketing approval processes is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You

Are both creative and execution-oriented—you enjoy developing content and campaign ideas and are equally energized by bringing them to life.

Liberty in North Korea is an international NGO working with the North Korean people to achieve their freedom by increasing access to information and technology inside the country, supporting resettled North Korean refugees in becoming agents of change, and providing humanitarian assistance through refugee rescues.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager owns the systems that connect our mission to new supporters and keep existing supporters engaged: marketing automation, advertising, and the tracking infrastructure that connects the two. This position goes beyond maintaining existing systems; it identifies gaps and builds the infrastructure required to grow LiNK's fundraising revenue, expanding our reach as we work toward the day when every North Korean person is free.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Paid Media (40%)

Manage the day-to-day operation of LiNK’s advertising accounts.
Build, launch, monitor, test, and optimize advertising campaigns focused on growth.
Build and maintain conversion tracking across all advertising platforms, ensuring accurate attribution from ad click through to form submission, donation, or other conversion events.
Work with the Assistant Director of Growth to set campaign measurement plans before launch: objectives, target audiences, conversion events, tracking, and reporting.
Develop and manage advertising strategy, including channel and audience targeting, to drive acquisition and revenue growth.

Request creative assets needed from graphic designer and filmmaker, including specifications, asset delivery, and versions for testing.

Marketing Automation and Technology (30%)

jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for workforce reinvention in the age of AI. We deliver integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems to help organizations expand their human + AI potential and thrive through change.

About the Role

OpenSesame is on a mission to become the global leader in corporate training and professional learning. As we expand our platform offerings and reinvent our workforce through AI adoption we are looking for an experienced Senior Product Marketing Manager to own this function within the organization and guide our strategic positioning, messaging, and enablement forward.

This role acts as the strategic centerpiece in our GTM org and is ideal for professionals who enjoy entrepreneurial ownership, cross-functional collaboration, and being a hands-on builder of strategy and assets.

Key Responsibilities:

Revenue Enablement:
Act as a subject-matter expert on messaging, market position, and competition. Develop GTM assets, case studies, and battlecards to aid the sales process.
Go-to-Market
- You’ll own the end-to-end GTM for the new product & features launching, from positioning & messaging, to asset creation, GTM launch management and internal enablement. You’ll collaborate with Product, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams to help create and test the positioning & messaging for your portfolios, which may include technology products and features, partnerships, or publishers.
GTM Impact Analysis:
Plan and execute ongoing analysis of the sales funnel, collateral kit, and GTM strategy inclusive of Win/Loss, sales cycle, engagement, and response.
Launch Program:
Build and manage a company-wide launch process for planning and directing the scope, schedule, and execution of our most critical moments.
Market Research:
Stay ahead of market trends, customer needs, and competitor moves. Engage with analysts and other industry stakeholders to build our brand and inform strategy. Use your insider-knowledge of our personas and industry to shape our unique approach to market.
Messaging & Positioning:
Build a compelling narrative around our products and value that we can take to market and win with. Help the organization tell our story more effectively by developing and aligning messaging, value propositions, and audiences.
Cross-Functional Alignment:
Collaborate with other teams to align GTM strategy, identify collateral needs, influence pricing and packaging, and ensure our market position is optimized for success.
Personal Effectiveness & AI utilization:
Create your own urgency, keep work organized, and have line of sight to achieving all deadlines. Have a plan to incorporate AI into the daily flow of work to contribute to your effectiveness.

Performance Objectives

First 30 Days:

Audit the existing selling collateral kit and sales playbook to identify areas of opportunity and notable gaps.
Refresh our competitor battlecards to reflect current market conditions and changes in messaging tied to AI.
Develop a working perspective on our brand messaging framework and identify gaps in implementation of this framework across the entire portfolio of channels and assets.
Create an initial POV on the key drivers of our value proposition that includes partners, publishers, and technology.
Establish relationships with key stakeholders across product management, sales, and the partner teams.
Learn about OpenSesame products and solutions and be able to accurately speak to their opportunities and position in the market.
Outline the plan for incorporating AI into the product marketing workflows.

First 90 Days:

Support GTM enablement as a subject-matter expert on messaging, market dynamics, competition, and positioning.
Establish a template and process for conducting company launches with an emphasis on cross-functional collaboration and audience optimization.
Establish a reporting cadence for key metrics including asset utilization, launch adoptions and outcomes, pipeline influence, and sales cycle metrics.
Collaborate with marketing stakeholders to build a messaging transition to in-market campaign process, determining key steps, templates, and RACI to ensure alignment between strategic messaging and positioning decisions and how we bring that to life in the market.
Build at least one LLM-based workflow to optimize your work.

First 6 Months:

Plan and engage analysts and industry stakeholders to evangelize OpenSesame’s products and position to share our story far and wide.
Deepen our GTM collateral kit through segmentation and targeting including industry-specific plays, persona targeted assets, and variable flows.
Utilize AI tools and processes to automate workflows, build templates, and gain organizational traction across the PMM function.
Leverage our robust publisher, partner, and customer audiences towards a combined narrative that compounds our value in the market.

By the end of Year 1:

Accelerate workflows across the GTM organization through streamlined, efficient processes, AI-enabled automations, and a fully realized PMM playbook.
Demonstrably accelerate and improve sales win rate, cycle speed, and engagement through improved collateral, processes, and strategic direction.
Help OpenSesame establish a defensible brand position as a global leader in corporate training and AI-enabled learning.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.
We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.
Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real.
Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location:
This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary.

Performance Driven:
We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.

Compensation:
The pay range for this position is generally between $140,000 and $170,000, depending on experience. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including professional development, ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off.

Benefits:
Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.

Equal Employment Opportunity:
OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

Pay Transparency:
At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

CPRA (California Candidates):
When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA.
This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy
or the California Attorney General's website.

We Care About Your Security:

If you receive a suspicious message, please contact us directly at careers@opensesame.com . Your security matters to us, thank you for staying vigilant.

About The Role

We're looking for a commercial expert with deep experience in the payer or life sciences
industry. You'll have spent your career marketing to, selling to, or enabling teams that sell into these organizations. As our Senior Industry Expert, you'll be the Revenue Operations team's in-house authority on these markets: how customers buy, what pressures they face, and what makes them say yes. You'll use that knowledge to shape how marketing, sales enablement and training, and sales operations go to market in these segments.

You'll set direction, pressure-test plans, and make sure every campaign, playbook, training program, and territory model reflects how our customers actually work. You'll partner closely with, Sales, Product, and other teams in RevOps to establish segment strategy.

What You'll Do

Be the voice of the customer. Act as the go-to expert on payer and/or life sciences customers: their business models, buying committees, budget cycles, regulatory environment, and top priorities. Turn that knowledge into guidance the whole RevOps team can use.
Shape segment RevOps strategy. Help set multi-year go-to-market strategy for payer and life sciences segments across marketing, sales enablement and training, and sales operations. Identify where we should focus, where we're underinvesting, and what needs to change.
Guide marketing direction. Advise on positioning, messaging, personas, and campaign strategy so marketing speaks the customer's language and addresses real business problems.
Raise the bar on sales readiness. Define what "industry fluent" means for our sellers. Shape enablement curricula, playbooks, discovery frameworks, and value messaging, and help subject matter experts and trainers deliver them credibly.
Inform sales operations. Give industry input on segmentation, account prioritization, territory design, pipeline expectations, and forecasting assumptions for these segments.
Track the market. Monitor industry trends, regulatory changes, competitive moves, and emerging customer needs. Translate them into clear implications and recommendations for leadership.
Build credibility in the field. Join strategic customer conversations and deal reviews when needed, and act as a trusted peer to sales leaders and account teams.
Connect the dots across functions. Bring Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success together around a shared view of segment opportunities and priorities.

What You Bring

6+ years in a commercial role (marketing, sales, or sales enablement) within or selling to the payer or life sciences industry.
Deep understanding of how your industry operates: organizational structures, key personas, buying processes, economic drivers, and regulatory context
Proven ability to think big picture and turn customer insight into sales and marketing strategy

Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families is the largest nonprofit dedicated to making military life better for families. Each year, we support over 1.5 million military- and veteran-connected family members through a national network of 300,000+ members and local chapters in communities across the country.

Our mission is simple and bold: We make military life awesome for families.

We listen, share, partner, and act to deliver evidence-based, data-driven solutions that work for real people. We’re a lifestyle organization, a friend and neighbor, and a trusted partner. Our approach is collaborative, human-centered, and designed with the whole family in mind.

A Blue Star Family is one with an immediate family member — a spouse, parent, or child — actively serving in the U.S. Armed Forces, including the Guard and Reserves. These families face unique challenges: frequent relocations, deployments, career disruption, and isolation. We respond with research-informed programs that create connection, build resilience, and foster a true sense of belonging.

We serve with urgency but build trust over time — because change happens at the speed of trust. Whether we’re driving spouse employment, supporting caregivers, or helping communities welcome military families, we strive for upstream solutions.

Who We’re Looking For

Bold thinkers. Fast movers. Smart collaborators. People who want to build, lead, and drive measurable change — and who care deeply about making an impact that matters.

What You’ll Do Here

Solve complex challenges with data, heart, and humility
Build cross-sector partnerships that get things done
Help military families feel at home wherever they live

If you're ready to work in a high-performance, mission-driven environment — and to make life better for those who serve — Blue Star Families is where you belong.

General Description

The Vice President, Direct Marketing & Peer-to-Peer Fundraising leads the strategy and performance of Blue Star Families' direct response and peer-to-peer fundraising programs. This role grows BSF's broad base of individual donors through multi-channel direct marketing. It also builds scalable peer-to-peer and grassroots giving programs that engage volunteers, ambassadors, chapter members and community members as fundraisers on behalf of military families.

Reporting to the Chief Development Officer and directly supervising [direct report title(s)], this leader partners closely with Marketing, Development Operations and Chapters/Programs staff to integrate direct marketing and peer-to-peer fundraising into the organization's broader revenue strategy.

This role requires the ability to travel overnight several times per year to attend team offsites, leadership sessions, fundraising events and company-wide events. Attendance and participation in these gatherings is a non-negotiable component of the position.

Key Job Functions

Direct Marketing & Mass-Market Fundraising

Oversee multi-channel direct response strategy, including donor acquisition, retention, reactivation, and upgrade pathways across direct mail, email, digital advertising, SMS, and other mass-market channels.
Set annual revenue goals, budgets and performance benchmarks for direct marketing programs.
Ensure rigorous segmentation, A/B testing, and performance-based ROI analysis to inform channel investment, with a bias toward rapid experimentation and scaling winning plays.
Manage relationships with external direct marketing vendors and agencies (e.g., MissionWired), ensuring quality, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness; hold partners to the same high-performance standard as internal team members.
Monitor campaign performance, donor acquisition costs, retention, and lifetime value metrics, adjusting strategy as needed.
Build a clear pathway that moves donors from first-time gifts to recurring, mid-level and major gift potential.

Peer-to-Peer & Grassroots Fundraising

Design and grow peer-to-peer fundraising programs (e.g., team and individual fundraising campaigns, DIY fundraising, ambassador programs) to diversify and expand BSF's donor base.
Partner with Marketing to build compelling peer-to-peer campaign assets, digital fundraising pages, and participant communications.
Develop toolkits, training and playbooks that equip volunteers, ambassadors and chapter leaders to fundraise effectively.
Set and track participant recruitment, fundraising, and retention goals across peer-to-peer campaigns.
Create a visible scoreboard and recognition program that celebrates top fundraisers and teams and fuels healthy competition.
Launch, test, and iterate on new peer-to-peer concepts quickly, scaling winning approaches and retiring those that underperform.
Convert peer-to-peer donors and participants into ongoing supporters through targeted direct marketing follow-up.

Team Leadership & Performance Management

Supervise staff and provide leadership and coaching to expand the chapter fundraising support function.
Develop, coach, and appraise staff to ensure high performance and professional growth, providing regular, candid feedback and addressing performance gaps promptly.
Build a high-talent-density team in which every member understands the strategy, owns their results, and makes decisions quickly.
Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture aligned with BSF values across the chapter network, grounded in freedom, responsibility, and accountability.

Program Integration & Cross-Functional Coordination

Partner with Marketing & Communications on donor messaging, campaign creative, branding and channel strategy.
Coordinate with the Chapters/Programs team to engage chapter members and volunteers in peer-to-peer campaigns.
Ensure alignment between direct marketing, peer-to-peer, major gifts, corporate and events strategies to build strong donor pipelines.

Systems, Data & Reporting

Oversee accurate tracking of chapter and peer-to-peer fundraising activity within the CRM, ensuring data integrity and consistent reporting.
Establish performance dashboards and revenue pacing for direct marketing and peer-to-peer channels, using them as a real-time scoreboard for the team.
Provide regular reporting to the Chief Development Officer, and to the Board as needed, on channel performance, donor retention and revenue forecasts.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Experience, Skills, Background

8+ years of progressive nonprofit development experience, including experience with chapter-based, affiliate, or peer-to-peer fundraising models.
3+ years of experience managing staff or leading a team.
Demonstrated experience building or scaling peer-to-peer, grassroots, or volunteer-driven fundraising programs.
A proven track record of meeting or exceeding ambitious revenue and participation goals, with specific, measurable wins you can speak to.
An athlete's mindset: high energy, competitive drive, resilience after setbacks, and a hunger to keep improving.
A coach's ability to motivate, hold accountable, and bring out the best in staff and volunteers alike.
Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy and accountability, and the ability to give and receive candid feedback.
Experience developing training, toolkits, or resources to support a distributed or volunteer fundraising network.
Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to motivate and support volunteer leaders across a geographically dispersed organization.
Demonstrated success working with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and peer-to-peer fundraising platforms.
Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to travel to chapters and organizational gatherings several times per year, including overnight travel.
May be required to work nights, weekends, and holidays as necessary to carry out key job functions.

Desired Experience, Skills & Background

Bachelor's degree in nonprofit management, business administration, or a related field.
Experience in membership-driven, chapter-based, or affiliate nonprofit organizations.
Familiarity with the military and Veteran-connected community.
Experience with peer-to-peer fundraising software (e.g., Classy, GoFundMe Charity, OneCause).
Experience in a high-growth, performance-driven culture (nonprofit or private sector).

More About Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families empowers military and Veteran families to thrive by connecting them with their civilian neighbors — both people and organizations — to create strong communities of mutual support. We believe we're all stronger when we take care of one another.

Our groundbreaking research is raising the nation's awareness of the unique challenges of military family life. With the help of neighbors across the country, Blue Star Families is overcoming the isolation and alienation of frequent moves, deployments, and reduced support from the government. Our innovative programs are solving specific challenges for military families, including fighting economic insecurity with resources that foster spouse career development, creating family strength with rich family programming, and providing critical peer support for caregivers, whose numbers are only increasing.

Blue Star Families is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

jobs.title: Lead Marketing Scientist
jobs.description:
The science is yours. The work is ours.

Due to unprecedented growth, we now need a part-time or full-time expert to join the team and work alongside our account directors to lead client engagements.

Our Account Director leads the client engagement. You support them with advisory.

You do none of the heavy lifting. No data collection, no model building, no slide production, no selling. The team does all of that and hands you the finished work: the model, the diagnostics, the planner output, the draft readout and the open questions. You of course make sure you are happy with every input and output along the way, and you can be as involved in that as you like.

WHAT YOU DO

Review the team's work and send it back with your notes. Two or three rounds is normal.

Decide what the evidence supports. Every readout ends in proceed, stage, test or defer.

Join the client call with the Account Director as the scientist in the room. You stand behind what you have reviewed, and say so when the evidence is not there.

Turn what you catch into checks the team runs next time.

ABOUT SEEDA

A six-year-old marketing mix modelling business with customers around the world. A full team in Vietnam, led from Sydney, collects the data, builds and refits the Bayesian models, runs the planner and writes the first draft of every readout, on an AI platform that does the heavy lifting.

HOW IT WORKS

Part-time or full-time, your choice. Part-time is about five hours in a brand's first month and four a month after that, growing with the brands we add. Your own practice can continue; the role is not exclusive. You get each brand's schedule and a written brief ahead of time.

The first brand is ready now: a US subscription brand in travel services, with a decision on a planned increase in media spend. Client calls are in US Eastern business hours; where you live is up to you.

YOU

5+ years in marketing science, marketing analytics or econometrics, with real marketing mix models behind you.
You have sat in front of a CMO or CFO and defended a model, and you have also told one what the model could not say.
Fluent in Bayesian MMM: priors, identifiability, adstock and saturation, holdouts, calibration against experiments.
You think in decisions and write with precision. A client reads your note and knows what to do on Monday.
Comfortable with an AI-first team: the first draft of everything you review was made with AI, and you know how to check it.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on LinkedIn with a few lines on the marketing mix models you have presented to clients. We reply to everyone, and the process from there is a conversation, then a short paid trial.

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Marketing
jobs.description:
About High Camp

High Camp was born from a love of craft cocktails and the great outdoors. What began as a Kickstarter campaign has grown into a brand known for premium, beautifully designed products that are built to last and made to share.

We design Fortified Barware for people who care about what they pour, wherever they pour it. We make it easy to craft and carry your favorite drinks everywhere from the backyard to the backcountry.

We're a lean team that has grown primarily through a strong direct-to-consumer business. Now we're building toward true omni-channel growth across DTC, wholesale/B2B, corporate gifting, and marketplaces. This hire is one of the most important seats in the company.

Head of Growth & Marketing

About the job

As Head of Growth & Marketing, you'll own High Camp's acquisition, retention, and revenue performance across our direct-to-consumer business, our largest revenue channel, while supporting marketing needs across the broader company. You'll lead our creative and performance marketing team, translate brand direction into marketing that performs across every channel, and oversee the partners and systems that power growth and e-commerce. This role is a deliberate middle ground between a pure growth operator and a CMO: strong growth fundamentals come first, with enough marketing range to serve the whole company.

This role reports to our CEO & you’ll lead an in-house team across creative, performance, and organic, and direct a roster of agency and contract partners covering media buying, email and SMS, video and design, web development, and emerging channels. You’ll own a seven-figure media budget, the partner relationships behind it, and the decisions about how this capability is resourced as we scale.

What you'll do

Own DTC growth and e-commerce performance.
Hold the DTC revenue target and contribution margin, not just top-line revenue. Whoever executes the work, the outcome sits with you.
Partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting.
Build the annual and peak-season paid media budget and an inventory-aware DTC forecast, set efficiency targets, and review performance against plan regularly.
Lead paid growth strategy.
Own risk analysis and go/no-go calls on paid and marketplace spend, using incrementality testing to know where the next marginal dollar earns the most.
Run creative as a performance lever.
Direct our in-house creative team and creative vendors, and build the creative testing program and creator/UGC pipeline that feed paid performance.
Grow organic reach.
Set direction for social, PR, affiliates and brand partnerships, and make sure they build demand that paid and retention can convert.
Own retention and lifecycle.
Set email and SMS strategy, calendar and LTV goals, and own the repeat purchase and LTV targets that come with them. You’ll work through a mix of in-house and partner resources, and you’ll shape how that mix evolves as the business scales.
Own go-to-market, launches and promotions.
Plan launches around when product actually lands and around wholesale and corporate timelines, own the promotional calendar, and translate brand direction from the founders into channel execution.
Make marketing show up for the whole company.
Make sure the content engine produces assets our wholesale and corporate custom teams can use, and that paid supports where DTC and B2B overlap, like corporate gifting in Q4. When channels compete for the same product, creative or spend, make the call that's right for the company.
Own the analytics and marketing tech stack.
Make sure tracking and reporting can be trusted, decide what to keep or retire, and direct the technical resources who run it.
Build the team.
Shape the growth and marketing functions as the business scales, deciding what to build in-house and what to contract or partner. We expect AI and automation to be a real part of that answer, so the function grows on leverage rather than headcount alone.

Key requirements

Owned the number.
You’ve owned a DTC P&L or contribution margin line at a brand doing $20M or more, and can describe the efficiency targets you were accountable for.
Came up as an operator.
You started as a media buyer or close to it, and you’ve since managed media buyers or agencies rather than only executing buys yourself.
Proven creative testing
. You’ve directed a creative team or vendors producing high-volume, fast-iteration content, and built a testing or creator/UGC program whose results changed where spend went.
Planned around real constraints
. You’ve forecast demand where supply was limited (long lead times, seasonal peaks, constrained launches) and adjusted spend to match.
Retention results.
You’ve grown repeat purchase or LTV through email and SMS, including work with outside partners.
Hands-on measurement.
You’ve run a tracking or analytics implementation and can walk us through it. You’re fluent in growth math (MER, CAC, contribution margin, incrementality) and can pressure-test any buyer’s or agency’s plan.
Built growth teams.
You’ve built and led growth teams, decided when to hire, contract or partner, and directed technical or e-commerce platform resources.
Tools.
Deep Shopify literacy, hands-on with Meta, Google and TikTok ads, and working knowledge of modern attribution tools.
Location:
Remote-friendly across the U.S., with hybrid co-working options available in Bozeman, MT; San Rafael, CA; or Golden, CO.
Travel:
Two team retreat/collaboration trips per year to a hub location, plus 2–3 additional business trips per year as needed.

Nice-to-haves

You’ve supported B2B, wholesale, retail or corporate gifting alongside DTC.
Experience on both sides of the agency table, or running an agency selection or transition.
Incrementality testing and media-mix modeling, or experience scaling newer channels like AppLovin and TikTok.
You’ve worked on premium consumer goods, lifestyle brands, or hard goods, where the product itself carries the brand.

Salary & benefits

Expected base salary range (San Francisco Bay Area): $170,000 - $210,000 USD. Offered compensation will vary based on geographic location, as well as relevant experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance.

Eligible for target bonus of 20% of base salary
Choice of three PPO medical plans, with employee coverage on our base plan 100% company-paid
Dental, vision, and HSA plan options
Flexible PTO
401(k) with up to 5% company match
Monthly cell phone stipend
Paid parental leave (16 weeks for birthing parents, 12 weeks for non-birthing parents)
Remote-friendly, with flexible schedules in a high-trust, high-autonomy culture
Office hubs and bi-annual company offsites for in-person collaboration and community

Applicants must be currently authorized to permanently work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor employment visas or provide relocation assistance.

new_jobs.description:
Description

We're reinventing how to attract and hire quality talent at scale — come join us.

We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to lead the strategy, execution and performance behind two of the AIM organization's most critical marketing functions: activation management and integrated marketing and campaign planning across Workforce Staffing's global hiring portfolio. This role starts with the customer: understanding hiring needs, translating them into marketing goals, and owning how those goals are achieved. You define how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are strategically planned, measured and optimized, and how the team scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.

As a marketing strategist and cross-functional operator, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across priority geographies globally. You translate complex performance data into decisive activation recommendations, manage daily pacing and spend governance, and own the narrative for senior leadership. You flex between deep-focus, data-rich environments and wide-focus, relationship-heavy environments with equal confidence.

You shape organizational strategy, build trust, drive clarity, and solve problems before they escalate.

Your insights don't just inform decisions — they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps and align business managers on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement. You build the trust, mechanisms, and reporting that close the existing gap. You don't wait for perfect data — you make decisions with what exists and build toward what's needed.

Key job responsibilities

Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the annual marketing strategy and plan the direction for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order trajectory across your portfolio. Lead quarterly strategy reviews, updating priorities based on performance data, market shifts, and evolving business needs. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Push back on media recommendations with data where channel performance does not support continued investment.

Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across assigned markets, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for assigned markets, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events. Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate changing labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive collaboration with Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Creative, Talent Engagement, Marketing Analytics, and Business stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams. Bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Manage a wide portfolio of countries with varying levels of data maturity, labour order certainty, and stakeholder sophistication.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Oversee daily pacing reviews, implementing ramp-down or pause decisions when application delivery targets are met. Share insights with Performance Marketing to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own escalation thresholds and spend decision governance.

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment: Own weekly and monthly Business Review deep dive presentations for senior leadership, translating risk sites and marketing performance into clear strategic narrative. Maintain regular alignment with Business Managers and cross-functional partners on fill rate risk and marketing actions. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases. Adapt communication to audience maturity — from sophisticated data-driven forums to foundational trust-building conversations.

Application Quality & Fill Rate Improvement: Monitor performance against goals including fill rate, non-paid application share, spend per hire, and application-to-usable application ratios. Implement data-driven optimisations for underperforming sites. Identify quality gaps (geo-targeting, shift messaging, channel mix) and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Creative, and Owned Marketing teams to resolve. Own the activation logic that balances cost efficiency with fill rate delivery.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes — from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with reviewing overnight pacing data across your markets and making activation decisions for the day. You join the weekly reporting call with your stakeholders, leading the marketing view for your area with a clear recommendation for each at-risk site. Mid-morning, you're on a stakeholder call with business partners in Brazil translating application pacing risk into language they understand and building alignment on marketing levers available. After lunch, you're deep-diving a high-spend site in Germany where channel efficiency has dropped — pulling site-level data, identifying the issue, and producing an internal discussion analysis for the Paid Marketing team. In the afternoon, you're working through quarterly initiatives with other teams — defining what to learn, which markets to test in, and how results will inform next quarter's strategy. Later, you prepare the MBR narrative for senior leadership, connecting this month’s activation decisions to fill rate outcomes. You close the day connecting the dots: what patterns are emerging across your portfolio, what's working, what needs to change, and how to translate that into the quarterly strategy update you're presenting to leadership next week.

About The Team

Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) team achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences — engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
Experience in marketing or marketing research
Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

Experience using SQL to pull data and metrics to deliver reports

new_jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Ads Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Description

Come build the future with us! What unites all Amazonians (across teams and geographies) is that we are all striving to delight customers and make their lives easier, whoever that customer may be. In pursuit of delighting customers, Amazonians have developed many products and services that transformed the way our customers live their lives and run their businesses. Together, we are building the future, one innovative product, service, and idea at a time.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, publishers, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including retail media, display, video, DSP, measurement, and ad tech solutions—leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys.

We're seeking a strategic and customer-obsessed Product Marketing Manager to join our Ads Product Marketing team. In this role, you'll serve as a critical bridge between product development and go-to-market execution, translating complex advertising solutions into compelling narratives that resonate with advertisers and drive product adoption at scale.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you'll partner closely with Product Management, Go-to-Market, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape product strategy through deep customer insights and competitive intelligence. You'll own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle—from informing the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research to crafting positioning and messaging that differentiates our solutions in market. Your work will directly influence how thousands of advertisers discover, adopt, and maximize value from Amazon Ads products.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with creative storytelling, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven track record of launching products that achieve measurable business impact. You'll need to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, moving seamlessly from conducting advertiser research to developing sales enablement materials to presenting product vision to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities

Collaborate with Product Managers to align on customer research priorities that will inform the product roadmap.
Conduct in-depth research and competitive analysis to identify the most promising opportunities for Amazon Ads products.
Communicate the product vision and direction to internal and external stakeholders to drive buy-in and adoption, establishing a regular cadence of stakeholder engagement.
Partner with Product Managers to recommend customer feedback prioritization, support effective Alpha/Beta testing, and refine the strategic roadmap.
Align GTM strategy to the product roadmap, translate complex product information into simple and clear language, and continue to gather customer feedback post-launch to inform future iterations.
Develop single-source-of-truth documentation to enable sales and marketing with positioning, messaging, product availability, best practices, implementation guides, and FAQs.

About The Team

The Ads Product Marketing team within Amazon Ads is the strategic connective tissue between product innovation and market impact. We don't just launch products, we shape how advertisers discover, understand, and derive value from Amazon's advertising solutions across the full funnel.

The Commerce pod sits at the heart of this mission, owning product marketing for some of Amazon Ads' core solutions: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Brand Stores. Together, these products serve millions of advertisers globally from small businesses running their first campaign to the large brands.

This role is part of the Sponsored Products & Sponsored Brands (SPB) product marketing team. We are evolving the PMM function beyond traditional launch communications to earning a seat at the table to directly influence the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research, competitive intelligence, and deep advertiser insights. Our work spans the full marketing lifecycle: from shaping what gets built, to how it's positioned in market, to driving adoption and measuring impact post-launch.

You'll join a collaborative, fast-paced team that partners daily with Product Management, Go-to-Market, Sales Enablement, and cross-functional leadership. We operate with a builder mentality by testing, learning, and iterating to deliver solutions that move the needle for advertisers and for the business. If you're passionate about translating complex ad tech into compelling stories that drive real outcomes, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience communicating results to senior leadership
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience in marketing or marketing research

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Description

Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company (biBERK) is building a cloud-first, API-driven insurance platform that enables small business owners to buy commercial policies directly online. We are seeking an analytical and technically minded Marketing Analyst
to join our team in Stamford, CT, to help scale our digital marketing analytics and performance reporting framework.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of growth marketing, data science, and web applications. You will leverage modern AI coding environments (such as Claude, Copilot) alongside core digital tracking tools (Google Ads, GA4) and Python/R web application frameworks to build real-time interactive dashboards. Your efforts will directly inform marketing investment, optimize digital acquisition funnels, and track key operational metrics for senior leadership

Job Responsibilities

Production Dashboard Engineering: Design, deploy, and support interactive analytical applications and custom web tools using Python (Streamlit) or R (Shiny). Build reporting systems to track direct-to-business marketing metrics, including quote-to-bind ratios, channel attribution, conversion velocities, and other funnel metrics. Use AI to build and maintain these dashboards on an azure environment.
AI-Accelerated Development: Serve as a functional champion for generative AI tools (Claude) within marketing operations. Utilize LLM workflows to accelerate code synthesis, automate data pipelines, and refactor analytical scripts to streamline dashboard delivery timelines.
Cloud & Data Integration: Partner with internal technology teams within the Azure ecosystem to integrate marketing data streams, support data warehouse migrations, and ensure secure deployment of analytical web applications.
Tracking Architecture & GA4 Optimization: Maintain and enhance digital analytics architecture across GA4 and Google Ads. Oversee custom dimension setups, event-driven tag management, and clean B2B lead attribution to ensure high data integrity across all digital channels.
Growth Experimentation & Media Testing: Design, run, and evaluate rigor-based media testing frameworks to measure true marketing incrementality. Execute Conversion Lift studies, Geo-Testing / Match-Market models, and A/B experiments across digital channels.

Requirements

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or business intelligence. Experience in B2B commercial insurance, financial services, or insurtech environments is strongly preferred.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or Data Science.
Location: Must reside within a viable commuting distance of our Stamford, CT office to attend required monthly strategy and team alignment session.
Development & Analytics Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python (Streamlit) and/or R (Shiny) for web application development and data visualization. Deep expertise in GA4 (event tracking, custom dimensions) and Google Ads management platforms. Hands-on experience using Claude/LLMs for code generation, workflow automation, and refactoring.
Database & Cloud: Foundational understanding of the Azure ecosystem for data storage, query optimization, or web application hosting.
Testing Methodologies: Proven understanding of statistical media testing, specifically Conversion Lift testing, Geo-Testing, and A/B experimentation architectures.
Preferred Skills: Prior experience with traditional enterprise BI platforms (Power BI or Tableau) is a plus.

About Us

biBerk is where commercial insurance buyers can obtain coverage for their businesses from insurers of the Berkshire Hathaway group of Insurance Companies, one of the best capitalized insurance groups in the world. Our ultimate parent, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (berkshirehathaway.com) is a holding company with diversified interests in a host of industries, including insurance, energy, transportation and manufacturing. Most policies issued through biBerk.com will be underwritten by Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company ("BHDIC"), which is an AM Best rated A++ insurer.

BHDIC is domiciled in Omaha, Nebraska. BHDIC and the team at biBerk are focused on helping small business owners quickly and easily buy affordable insurance directly from a financially strong insurance company they can trust.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Job Title

Marketing Intern, HCP Education & Engagement

Why Genmab

At Genmab, interns don’t just learn about the work - they help move it forward. Our internship program provides meaningful, hands-on experience through real projects that directly support our teams, business priorities, and mission to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases.

From day one, interns are welcomed as part of the team and given opportunities to contribute, collaborate, and make an impact. Along the way, you’ll learn from talented colleagues and senior leaders, build new skills, expand your professional network, and gain exposure to the innovative work happening across Genmab.

We’re always looking for smart, curious, purpose-led people who are ready to bring fresh perspectives and bold ideas. Explore our website to learn more about Genmab and how you could play a role in our bold, extra[not]ordinary® future.

Job Overview

The Gyn-Oncology Marketing Intern, HCP Education & Engagement will support the U.S. Gynecologic Oncology Commercial Marketing team in the development and execution of healthcare professional (HCP) educational initiatives that support launch readiness and customer engagement. This internship provides hands-on experience across peer-to-peer education, speaker bureau strategy and execution, congress engagement, third-party educational programming, and professional promotional initiatives within the gynecologic oncology space.

The intern will work closely with cross-functional partners, including Marketing, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, Commercial Operations, and agency teams, to help develop educational resources and support execution of key HCP-facing initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Support the planning, development, and execution of HCP peer-to-peer educational initiatives within the gynecologic oncology marketplace.
Assist in the creation, review, and management of speaker program materials, including presentation decks, case studies, discussion guides, FAQs, and program support resources.
Support Speaker Bureau activities through content management, material updates, speaker communications, training resources, and program logistics.
Assist with development of educational and promotional content that supports healthcare professional awareness and engagement within gynecologic oncology.
Support the planning and execution of live and virtual HCP educational programs, speaker programs, and peer-to-peer broadcasts.
Assist in the development and coordination of congress-related activities and materials, including promotional assets, exhibit resources, educational communications, and post-congress engagement initiatives.
Support third-party educational programs and sponsorship opportunities with professional organizations and educational partners relevant to gynecologic oncology.
Conduct competitive intelligence and marketplace research to understand peer education trends, speaker program approaches, congress activities, and HCP engagement strategies across the oncology landscape.
Assist with launch readiness activities, including educational planning, promotional material development, content preparation, and cross-functional coordination.
Support omnichannel marketing initiatives that extend peer-to-peer educational content across multiple HCP engagement channels.
Help maintain educational content libraries, speaker resources, and promotional materials to ensure organization, accessibility, and version control.

Explore innovative digital tools and AI-enabled solutions that may improve content development, educational program support, and customer engagement.

Interest in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or oncology marketing.
Interest in gynecologic oncology and healthcare professional education.

Experience developing presentations, marketing materials, communications, or educational content through coursework, internships, or extracurricular activities.

This role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship at the time of the application or in the future.

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. Description

Are you energized by turning creative ambition into a system that reliably produces it? The Reputation Marketing & Insights Creative team is looking for a Sr Creative Program Manager to own the process and production layer of our operating model, systems, and output for how advertising creative actually gets made. You will report to the L7 Head of Creative, with a dotted line to the org-wide Operations lead. You will you translate org-level operational goals into a working creative production model, run it, and feed capacity, cost, and throughput signals back up to inform the broader strategy. A core part of the role is raising operational consistency across the wider organization.

In practice, you set the standards that the Creative team executes against. You make critical calls on how work flows, where capacity goes, and what "good" looks like operationally — decisions that shape long-term creative output and business outcomes.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and creative production. You thrive on ambiguous problems, lead cross-functional teams without owning the reporting line, and actively explore how generative AI can augment creative production — compressing timelines, expanding output, and lowering cost per asset without lowering the bar.

Key job responsibilities

Execute the org's operations strategy within the creative-production domain — translating operating goals (efficiency, cost, scale, quality) into a concrete production model and deliver against them.

Design, own, and continuously improve the end-to-end creative production operating model — intake, prioritization, resourcing, workflow, review/approval, and delivery.

Set the standards, process, and quality bar for our project management and production outputs

Provide the production-side inputs to org-level operations planning — capacity forecasts, cost-per-asset and throughput data, and resourcing tradeoffs — and translate those inputs into budget and resourcing decisions.

Own capacity and resource planning across the team and external partners — forecast demand, allocate against competing priorities, and make the tradeoff calls when demand exceeds capacity.

Select, implement, and own the systems and tooling that run creative production (project/asset management, workflow automation, reporting), and drive adoption across the team.

Establish the metrics that define production health — throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery, rework, cost per asset — and use them to drive measurable improvement.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
7+ years in creative production, creative operations, or program management within a marketing/creative environment.
Experience owning production workflow and resourcing across multiple concurrent programs or campaigns.
Experience leading or providing structured direction to lateral partners.
Experience managing external agencies or production vendors, including budgets and SOWs.
Proficiency with creative/project management tooling (e.g., Asana, Workfront, Airtable, or equivalent).

Experience using data and metrics to improve processes and customer satisfaction
Experience designing a creative operating model from the ground up or materially re-architecting an existing one.
Experience scaling creative production across channels (video, digital, social, experiential) and high asset volume.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
